title: Test network quality and speed
summary: Use the built-in networkQuality tool to measure your internet connection's speed and quality. It tests upload and download speeds and reports latency and responsiveness.

steps.explain: Run the network quality test on your default network interface. This will measure your upload and download speeds, latency, and responsiveness.

alternatives.explain: Test a specific network interface (e.g., en0 for Wi-Fi) instead of the default one.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The network interface to test, e.g., en0 for Wi-Fi, en1 for Ethernet.

alternatives.explain: Show detailed verbose output including more metrics.
Test upload and download speeds sequentially instead of in parallel.
